title: Easy Air Fryer Sweet Potato Stuffed Bites

ingredients: Cooked ground beef, seasoned to your liking
steps: Mix the mashed sweet potato and flour until a soft dough forms. Knead with your hands.
Roll into balls, then flatten each one.
Add a spoonful of seasoned ground beef and a little mozzarella cheese to the center.
Pinch the dough closed and roll back into a ball.
Place on parchment paper in your air fryer and brush the tops with olive oil.
Air fry at 325°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through (10 minutes per side), until lightly golden. The sweet potato bread will turn slightly brown and crack a little.
caption: ✨ Easy Air Fryer Sweet Potato Stuffed Bites ✨ These bites are soft, cheesy, and packed with protein—perfect for little hands! It’s a plus not having to turn on the oven during the summer too 💛 🧡 Ingredients: • 1 cup mashed sweet potato • ½ cup all-purpose flour • Cooked ground beef, seasoned to your liking • Mozzarella cheese • Olive oil 👩🏻‍🍳 Directions: 1. Mix the mashed sweet potato and flour until a soft dough forms. Knead with your hands. 2. Roll into balls, then flatten each one. 3. Add a spoonful of seasoned ground beef and a little mozzarella cheese to the center. 4. Pinch the dough closed and roll back into a ball. 5. Place on parchment paper in your air fryer and brush the tops with olive oil. 6. Air fry at 325°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through (10 minutes per side), until lightly golden. The sweet potato bread will turn slightly brown and crack a little.  💡 Feel free to switch up the filling with whatever your toddler loves—shredded chicken, veggies, beans, or different cheeses all work great! ❤️ Save this recipe and like & follow for more simple toddler recipes! #easyrecipe #toddlermeals #toddlersnacks #toddlerlunch #toddlerdinner
